These are the libraries you will need. RStudio should prompt you to install them
when it opens, but if not you can type install.packages("readxl") for each of 
them in the console
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(paletteer)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
```
#Make sure the xlsx file is in the same folder as this R-file
```{r}
DLTdv8_Data <- read_excel("DLTdv8 Model Videos Data.xlsx", na = "inf")
View(DLTdv8_Data)


# This removes rows with missing data
DLTdv8_Data <- na.omit(DLTdv8_Data)

DLTdv8_Data <- DLTdv8_Data %>%
  arrange(Model, Freq.Hz)
```

#Kinematic Analysis
```{r}
DLTdv8_summary <- DLTdv8_Data %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Used.in.analysis?` == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(across(c(waveSpeed.ms, ScaledY1amp.mm, ScaledY2amp.mm),
                ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(waveSpeed.ms = ifelse(is.infinite(waveSpeed.ms), NA, waveSpeed.ms)) %>%
  group_by(Model, Freq.Hz) %>%
  summarize(across(c(waveSpeed.ms, ScaledY1amp.mm, ScaledY2amp.mm),
                   list(mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Frequency and Tail Amplitude
ggplot(data = DLTdv8_summary, aes(x = Freq.Hz, y = ScaledY1amp.mm_mean, color = Model)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#CC6677", "#332288", "#117733", "#AA4499", "#882255","#44AA99", "#88CCEE", "#6699CC")) +
  xlab("Actuator Frequency") +
  ylab("Tail Amplitude (mm)") +
  geom_line()
ggsave("FreqvTailAmp.png", height = 5, width = 5, units = "in")

# Frequency at Tail vs Head
ggplot(data = DLTdv8_Data, aes(x = Y2freq, y = Y1freq, color = Model))+ #ggplot line
  geom_point(size = 5)+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#CC6677", "#332288", "#117733", "#AA4499", "#882255","#44AA99", "#88CCEE", "#6699CC"))+
  xlab("Head Frequency")+
  ylab("Tail Frequency")+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE) #geometry line
ggsave("HeadvTailFreq.png", height = 5, width = 5, units = "in")

# Frequency and Wavespeed
ggplot(DLTdv8_summary, aes(x = Freq.Hz, y = waveSpeed.ms_mean, color = Model, group = Model)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#CC6677", "#332288", "#117733", "#AA4499", "#882255","#44AA99", "#88CCEE", "#6699CC")) 
ggsave("WaveSpeedvFreq.png", height = 5, width = 5, units = "in")

# Amplitude Ratio
ggplot(data = DLTdv8_Data, aes(x = Y2amp, y = Y1amp, color = Model))+ #ggplot line
  geom_point(size = 5)+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#CC6677", "#332288", "#117733", "#AA4499", "#882255","#44AA99", "#88CCEE", "#6699CC"))+
  xlab("Head Amplitude")+
  ylab("Tail Amplitude")+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE) #geometry line
ggsave("HeadTailAmplitudes.png", height = 5, width = 6, units = "in")


```
R Colors: https://sape.inf.usi.ch/quick-reference/ggplot2/colour
R Color Palettes: https://r-graph-gallery.com/38-rcolorbrewers-palettes.html

```{r}
lm_eqn <- function(y,x){
    m <- lm(y ~ x);
    eq <- substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2, 
         list(a = format(unname(coef(m)[1]), digits = 2),
              b = format(unname(coef(m)[2]), digits = 2),
             r2 = format(summary(m)$r.squared, digits = 3)))
    as.character(as.expression(eq));
}
```

#Scatterplots ()
```{r}
# Separating by Model
library(dplyr)
AModels <- dplyr::filter(DLTdv8_Data, Model == "A")
BModels <- dplyr::filter(DLTdv8_Data, Model == "B")
CModels <- dplyr::filter(DLTdv8_Data, Model == "C")
DModels <- dplyr::filter(DLTdv8_Data, Model == "D")
EModels <- dplyr::filter(DLTdv8_Data, Model == "E")
FModels <- dplyr::filter(DLTdv8_Data, Model == "F")
GModels <- dplyr::filter(DLTdv8_Data, Model == "G")
HModels <- dplyr::filter(DLTdv8_Data, Model == "H")

# Amplitude Ratios
amplitude_ratios <- DLTdv8_Data %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Used.in.analysis?` == "Yes") %>%
  group_by(Model, Freq.Hz) %>%
  summarise(amp_ratio = mean(Y1amp / Y2amp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(amplitude_ratios,
       aes(x = Freq.Hz, y = amp_ratio, color = Model)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Frequency (Hz)",
       y = "Amplitude Ratio (Tail / Head)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#CC6677", "#332288", "#117733", "#AA4499", "#882255","#44AA99", "#88CCEE", "#6699CC"))+
  theme_classic()
ggsave("AmpRatiosvFreq.png", height = 5 , width = 10.5, units = "in")

amplitude_ratios <- amplitude_ratios %>%
  mutate(
    model = factor(Model),
    frequency = factor(Freq.Hz)
  )

amplitude_ratios$model <- factor(amplitude_ratios$model)


# Do model and frequency predict amplitude ratios?
lm1 <- lm(amp_ratio ~ model + Freq.Hz, data = amplitude_ratios)
anova(lm1)

# model-specific frequency response
lm2 <- lm(amp_ratio ~ model * Freq.Hz, data = amplitude_ratios)
anova(lm2)

# does freq predict amp ratio
lm3 <- lm(amp_ratio ~ Freq.Hz, data = amplitude_ratios)
anova(lm3)


# does model predict amp ratio
anova_model <- aov(amp_ratio ~ model, data = amplitude_ratios)
summary(anova_model)

tukey_models <- TukeyHSD(anova_model, "model")

print(tukey_models)

```
